preferences.auto_move_hint: Play the only legal move automatically
preferences.move_hints_hint: Gold dot beside points you can move from
preferences.sound_hint: Soft dice, hits, and win cues — respects silent mode

review.viewing_hint: Reviewing — tap Live or Back to live to keep playing

bear_off.hint: Select point 3, then tap the bear-off area on the right edge.
bear_off.praise: Off the board! First to bear off all 15 wins.
bear_off.show_body: All your checkers are in your home (points 1–6). You can now remove them from the board. Roll a 3 — take the checker on the 3-point off.
bear_off.subtitle: Remove checkers to win
bear_off.title: Bearing off

blocked_points.hint: The highlighted stack of two black checkers on point 5.
blocked_points.praise: Right — a made point (2+) is closed. Empty, your own, or a blot (1) are open.
blocked_points.show_body: Two or more opponent checkers on a point block it. You can't land there. Find the blocked point.
blocked_points.subtitle: Know what you can't do
blocked_points.title: Blocked points

doubles.hint: Tap the 8-point, then the 6-point. Do this four times — once per die.
doubles.praise: Exactly — doubles mean four moves with that number.
doubles.show_body: Rolling doubles gives you four moves instead of two. You rolled 2-2 — that's four 2s. Move from the 8-point to the 6-point, four times.
doubles.subtitle: Four moves, not two
doubles.title: Doubles

enter_bar.hint: Tap the bar, then point 21 (not 23 — that's the 2).
enter_bar.praise: You're back on the board — bar checkers always enter first.
enter_bar.show_body: A checker on the bar must re-enter before you can move anything else. Die N enters on point 25−N. You rolled a 4 — enter on point 21.
enter_bar.subtitle: Bar checkers move first
enter_bar.title: Enter from bar
enter_bar.wrong: That's the 2 (point 23). Use the 4 — enter on point 21 (25−4).

find_home.hint: Home is the six points in the bottom-right quadrant — numbered 1 through 6.
find_home.praise: That's your home — checkers leave the board from here.
find_home.show_body: Your home board is points 1 through 6. This is where all your checkers need to end up before you can bear them off. Tap any home point.
find_home.subtitle: Where checkers finish
find_home.title: Find home

hit_blot.hint: Tap your checker on 8, then tap point 5.
hit_blot.praise: Hit! That black checker is now on the bar.
hit_blot.show_body: A single checker sitting alone is called a blot. Land on it and it gets sent to the bar. You rolled a 3 — hit the black blot on the 5-point.
hit_blot.subtitle: Send them to the bar
hit_blot.title: Hit a blot

opening_roll.hint: Every game starts with one die each — higher goes first.
opening_roll.praise: Now you know how every game begins.
opening_roll.show_body: Every game of backgammon starts with both players rolling one die. Higher roll goes first and uses both numbers for the opening move.
opening_roll.subtitle: The opening roll
opening_roll.title: Opening roll

overshoot.hint: Select point 3, then tap the bear-off tray.
overshoot.praise: That's the overshoot rule — you'll use it a lot when bearing off.
overshoot.show_body: Nothing is on the 5-point, but you rolled a 5. When there's no checker on the number you rolled, bear off from your highest occupied point instead.
overshoot.subtitle: Larger die still works
overshoot.title: Overshoot

play_both_dice.hint: Select a white checker, then tap point 5. Do this for both the 8-point and the 6-point.
play_both_dice.praise: Nice — both dice used. Same checker or two checkers, both numbers must be played when you can.
play_both_dice.show_body: Each turn you roll two dice and must play both when possible. You rolled 3 and 1 — move the 8-point checker three pips (to 5), and the 6-point checker one pip (to 5).
play_both_dice.subtitle: Two dice, two moves
play_both_dice.title: Both dice

roll_move.hint: Tap the white checker on 8, then tap point 5.
roll_move.praise: You moved! That's the core of backgammon — roll dice, move checkers.
roll_move.show_body: Roll the dice, then move a checker that many points. You rolled a 3 — move the white checker from point 8 to point 5.
roll_move.subtitle: Roll and move
roll_move.title: Roll & move

the_bar.hint: Tap the vertical strip between the left and right halves of the board.
the_bar.praise: Right — hit checkers sit on the bar until they re-enter.
the_bar.show_body: The raised strip in the middle is called the bar. When your checker gets hit, it waits here until you re-enter. Tap the bar.
the_bar.subtitle: Hit checkers wait here
the_bar.title: The bar

your_direction.hint: Tap the white checker on 8, then tap point 5.
your_direction.praise: You're moving the right way — from high to low, toward your home.
your_direction.show_body: Your checkers move in a horseshoe: from the far side, across, then into your home (points 1–6). You always move toward lower numbers. Move this checker in the correct direction.
your_direction.subtitle: Which way to move
your_direction.title: Direction

feedback.illegal: Try a highlighted point — or tap Hint.
feedback.legal_but_wrong: That's legal in a real game — here, try the move that teaches this idea.

learn.home_cta_ready: You're ready — play a real game
learn.subtitle: 12 challenges — learn by playing
learn.title: Learn to play
